# The AI Insider Brief

> brief.shiftandlead.com is the open AI briefing from Shift & Lead, run
> by Fatiha Chikh, an enterprise operator with 20+ years at Dell, Intel, and
> Microsoft who now runs her own business on 99 AI employees, in public.

This page is an open briefing for business owners, senior managers, and
professionals who need to understand AI without becoming engineers. Its bot
researches trusted sources twice daily, and reviewed cards explain what affects
a business in direct, accessible language. No signup is required. Current cards separate source
evidence from judgment. ACT is reserved for a verified action. WATCH names
the event that would trigger action. IGNORE explains why the reader can
safely skip the signal. Some people know Fatiha as "The AI Automation Queen," a nickname,
not a title.

## Key pages

- This briefing: https://brief.shiftandlead.com
- Free guide library (guides.shiftandlead.com): https://guides.shiftandlead.com/free-resources.html
- Business site, Fast Forward course: https://www.shiftandlead.com/fast-forward.html

## Usage terms

Content on this page may be cited or quoted with attribution and a link back
to the source page. It may not be used to train, fine-tune, or build machine
learning models of any kind.
